_meta.description: What FIU-IND has published about exchanges the label files name: whether each was on FIU-IND's list of registered VDA service providers as of 9 Mar 2026, and the notices, takedown directions and penalties FIU-IND announced, each with its date and source. A fact about the exchange, never about any customer. Read by app/fiu_ind_status.py only with EXCHEQUER_FIU_IND_NOTE on: the report's FINDING and the exchange letters then carry one short note. Labels are not changed.
_meta.provenance: Government sources only, each read directly on 2026-11-15: PIB releases 1991372 (28 Dec 2023), 2098153 (31 Jan 2025), 2173758 (1 Oct 2025) and 2308131 (9 Sep 2026); Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 5805, answered 30 Mar 2026 (Annexure-I: the 54 VDA SPs registered with FIU-IND as on 09.03.2026; Annexure-II: the 53 directed for takedown of their apps and URLs); FIU-IND Orders-in-Original 08, 10, 15 and 16/DIR/FIU-IND/2024. An action's date is the date the source gives (a PIB release's date is the date it was announced; Annexure-II gives no dates, so its date is the day of the answer). Order 15 is dated 31.01.2025 and Order 16 06.03.2025 in the PDFs; FIU-IND's order index shows 2024 dates; the PDF dates are used.
_meta.rule: An exchange is listed only if a source above names it and its name maps to one exchange name in the label files. 'registered' is true only for a trade name in USQ 5805 Annexure-I, and says nothing about any date after 9 Mar 2026: FIU-IND publishes no register (USQ 5805(f)). Annexure-II records directions issued at some time, not current blocking; four exchanges on it are also in Annexure-I. An Annexure-II row is cited only where no PIB release records the action. Left out: Delta Exchange (Annexure-I names Excelium Technologies, India; the label files do not say which Delta Exchange their wallet is) and the 39 named exchanges with no wallet in the label files.
